versions.subject: feat: aspnet compile + agentexecutor rename
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\aspnet_compiler.exe'
selection_child:
    # Note: add other potential suspicious child processes and paths
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\calc.exe'
        - '\notepad.exe'
    - Image|contains:
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\AppData\Local\Roaming\'
        - ':\Temp\'
        - ':\Windows\Temp\'
        - ':\Windows\System32\Tasks\'
        - ':\Windows\Tasks\'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\aspnet_compiler.exe" Image IN ("*\\calc.exe", "*\\notepad.exe") OR Image IN ("*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Roaming\\*", "*:\\Temp\\*", "*:\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "*:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\*", "*:\\Windows\\Tasks\\*")
